# Our values
Founded in 2020 with the belief that beauty industry requires a revolution with respect to TRANSPARENCY. There is lot of inaccurate advice & incorrect claims being made by beauty brands which results in fear mongering, misconceptions and eventually consumers making wrong decisions.
For example, the blind march towards beauty products with 'Natural' claims is really concerning. There is a misconception that 100% natural is safe & effective and anything that sounds like a chemical is unsafe. This is completely wrong.
"Everything is a chemical – water is a chemical – therefore, chemical-free products don’t exist."
We wanted to address this issue of lack of transparency through a range of products that are straightforward, honest and do what they claim to do. No unnecessary marketing fluff. And this is how Minimalist was born.

## About Us
Minimalist is a high-performance skincare brand rooted in scientific research. It was founded in 2020 with a belief that the skincare industry requires a revolution with respect to transparency of ingredients.
With products ranging from cleansers, serums, moisturizers, and sunscreens, Minimalist offers highly efficacious & targeted solutions for a variety of skin, hair, and body concerns like acne, pigmentation, ageing, dehydration, hair fall, and dandruff, amongst others
## Clinically Proven
## Recommended by Dermatologist
Our mission is to improve skin health. Dedicated to this purpose, we make one simple promise—to provide advanced skincare backed by science.
## Global Expansion
We cater to an ever expanding community of 300 million+ customers across 5 continents and 17 countries with a mission to grow further.
## Our Aspiration
At Minimalist, we aim to make skincare simple, honest, and backed by science.We aim to eliminate the guesswork from skincare, empowering individuals with trustworthy products and knowledge to make informed choices.
## Our Values
At Minimalist, we are guided by the following principles, which define our approach to business and our commitment to our stakeholders:
### High-Performance
### Transparency
## Beyond Work
At Minimalist, we go beyond work to ensure our employees thrive. Here are some benefits we offer:
Health & Well Being
1. Comprehensive health insurance for employees and their family.
2. 24*7 On Call Ambulance Service available for all employees
3. Inhouse Medical room with Nurse available at Manufacturing site
4. Regular Preventive Health Checkups
Experience & Celebration
Celebration is a part of our culture — because we believe that meaningful connections are built beyond the desk. Vibrant festive events, indoor and outdoor sports tournaments, and team get-togethers that bring us closer as a community.
Work-Life Harmony
A supportive work environment that values work-life balance.
## Culture at Minimalist
We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where every idea is valued. Our culture thrives on curiosity, respect, and a shared passion for creating effective skincare solutions.
## Careers
We’re always on the lookout for passionate individuals who align with our values and vision. Whether you’re a skincare enthusiast, a creative mind, or a scientific expert, there’s a place for you at Minimalist.
Let’s revolutionize skincare together.

# Vitamin C 10% Face Serum
For Brighter, Glowing & Healthy Looking Skin
A glow-boosting daily serum packaged with the goodness of Vitamin C & Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) that brightens and tones sun damaged and dull skin with dark spots.
"Takes some time to show the results on the face! Adds an amazing glow on the face once it starts showing results! Loved it :) -Nikhila R."
- Made with stabilized Vitamin C derivative "Ethyl Ascorbic Acid" that has 86% pure Vitamin C content. That is much higher than 40-50% content present in other Vitamin C derivatives. At a pH of ~4.0 it is highly stable and effective
- Contains 1% Acetyl Glucosamine (AG), an amino-monosaccharide (simple sugar) and a precursor of hyaluronic acid, that provides skin moisturization, boosts natural Hyaluronic Acid synthesis, and regulates natural exfoliation
- Boosted with Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) which are new age hydroxy acids, suitable even for sensitive skin. PHAs gently remove dead skin cells to give skin a glow. Also have antioxidant/chelation, barrier strengthening, and moisturizing effects
- Formulated in Centella Water to soothe and heal skin Formulated with ET-VC, high purity Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, from Corum Inc, Taiwan
Skin type: All skin types

Suitable for: 16+ years of age

Vitamin C is a proven skin-brightener and antioxidant for decades. It boosts collagen formation and effectively targets visible signs of ageing, giving skin the much-needed glow.

# Vitamin K + Retinal 1% Eye Cream
Reduces dark circles, puffiness & fine lines
A lightweight under-eye cream swiftly combats dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines with a quick-absorbing, non-tacky formula. Vitamin K diminishes dark circles, Caffeine reduces puffiness, and Retinal enhances skin texture. Synergistic Peptides tackle dark circles and puffiness, while Zerumbone addresses hyperpigmentation. Hyaluronic Acid and Aquaporin boosters ensure comprehensive hydration.
- Vitamin K, a potent ally in tackling dark circles, effectively combats under-eye discoloration and fortifies fragile blood vessels, contributing to a reduction in dark circles
- Retinal, positioned as the intermediate stage in the conversion from retinol to retinoic acid, showcases remarkable anti-aging attributes. These include the reduction of fine lines & dark circles, all while being significantly better tolerated than Retinoic acid.
- The trio of Dipeptide-2, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, and Hesperidin Methyl Chalcone collaborates to reduce capillary permeability, boost lymphatic flow, and mitigate inflammation, resulting in a smoother under-eye area. Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, working in tandem, enhance under-eye firmness and contribute to an even skin tone, rejuvenating the under-eye appearance
- To comprehensively address dark circles, our formulation incorporates Chrysin, N-hydroxysuccinimide, and Zerumbone, targeting and eliminating the root causes of these under-eye concerns. This multi-pronged approach leaves your under-eye area feeling refreshed and visibly brighter. All our ingredients are sourced from leading global suppliers. Our high purity grade Vitamin K is sourced from Mckinely, USA.

## Ingredients
Vitamin K strengthens blood vessel walls, potentially enhancing under-eye microcirculation. This can help in reducing under-eye discoloration and minimizing dark circles.
As an intermediary between retinoic acid and retinol, Retinal activates in one step. It's an anti-aging powerhouse, reducing wrinkles and enhancing skin texture.
Combat under-eye bags with Eyeliss, a unique blend of Hesperidin derivative, Dipeptide-2, and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7. This powerful trio works to reduce capillary vessel permeability, improve lymphatic circulation, and enhance skin firmness and elasticity for a youthful look.
Experience enhanced firmness and tone in your eye area with the synergistic blend of Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 matrikines. Chrysin & N-hydroxysuccinimide target and eliminate the root causes of dark circles and puffiness, clearing away bilirubin and soluble iron for a rejuvenated appearance.
